description: This Java source file defines a class 'Hooks' using the Cucumber framework annotations (@Before, @After) to manage WebDriver lifecycle during BDD test scenarios. It handles initialising web drivers, logging configurations, capturing screenshots on failure, and ensuring the configuration is logged exactly once per test run.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: A class implementing Cucumber hooks to manage setup and teardown of WebDriver instances, log configurations, and attach screenshots for failed tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Executed before each test scenario; logs configuration details once and initializes a new WebDriver instance.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Executed after each test scenario; captures a screenshot upon failure and quits the WebDriver.

methods.name: logConfigOnce
methods.description: Ensures environment configuration summary is logged only once per test run, using synchronization to prevent race conditions.

methods.name: captureScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the current browser state and attaches it to the Cucumber report, handling exceptions gracefully.
